description: List recent emails from the inbox. Optionally filter by label. Returns message IDs with flattened from/to/subject/date fields plus snippet and labels.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

label.description: Label to filter by (e.g., "INBOX", "SENT", "STARRED", "IMPORTANT", or custom label). Defaults to INBOX.

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 10)

name: gws-mcp__gmail_list
